Function Documentation

HxResult HxSoundClose ( HxSoundID_t  id  ) 

Close a sound resource.

This function will close a sound resource, remove any resources from memory, and so on. The resource id is no longer applicable in any other audio APIs.

Parameters:
id IN: Sound resource id
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxSoundOpen ( const char *  filePath,
HxSoundID_t *  id 
)

Open a known source resource.

This function will open a known source resource and return a unique sound reference that is then used in other high level audio APIs.

Parameters:
filePath IN: Absolute file path to the sound file
id OUT: Sound resource id
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxSoundPlay ( HxSoundID_t  id  ) 

Play a sound resource.

This function will play back a known sound resource.

Parameters:
id IN: Sound resource id
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxSoundPlayFile ( const char *  filePath  ) 

Play a sound file.

This function will play the specified sound file. It plays the sound in its own thread to allow normal system processing to continue.

Parameters:
filePath IN: Absolute file path to the sound file
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxSoundPlaySystemSound ( HxSystemSound_t  soundID  ) 

Play the system sound beep.

This function will play the defined system beep sound. It plays the sound in its own thread to allow normal system processing to continue.

Parameters:
soundID IN: System sound ID to be used
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxSoundStop ( HxSoundID_t  id  ) 

Stop a sound resource.

This function will stop a currently playing sound resource.

Parameters:
id IN: Sound resource id
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxSoundWait ( HxSoundID_t  id  ) 

Wait for a sound to finish playing.

This function will block as long as a sound resource is playing.

Parameters:
id IN: Sound resource id
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.
